description: Free (no credits): one comparison image from a before and an after photo of the same place — e.g. an empty room and its virtual staging, a daylight shot and its dusk version, a room before and after a restyle. Side by side, stacked, or split by a line; original shape, square, 4:5 or 9:16. Write the labels in the user's language. Returns a finished image at once. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

afterImageUrl.description: The AFTER photo (e.g. the staged room, the dusk version). Public https URL or data: URI; or afterR2Path.

afterLabel.description: Label text for the after photo, in the user's language (default "After").

afterR2Path.description: Storage path of the after photo — the alternative to afterImageUrl.

aspect.description: Shape of the image: original (follows the photos), 1:1 square, 4:5 Instagram post, 9:16 Stories/Reels.

beforeImageUrl.description: The BEFORE photo (e.g. the empty room, the daylight shot). Public https URL or data: URI; or beforeR2Path.

beforeLabel.description: Label text for the before photo, in the user's language (default "Before").

beforeR2Path.description: Storage path of the before photo — the alternative to beforeImageUrl. For a Pixly result, its original photo is the job's source.

layout.description: side = next to each other, stack = one above the other, vsplit = one frame split by a vertical line, diagonal = split by a slanted line.

name: before_after_image

status.description: pending | processing | completed | failed — anything not completed/failed is still running

title: Before & After Image
